unresolved.issue: Very faint grey traces of writing lie in the upper part of the page, about x 450–1300, y 300–500, above the first heavier ruled line. There are further faint traces across the ruled area. None is legible. They are most likely show-through or offset from adjacent leaves: their extent loosely matches the long top line of fol. 32 and the text of fol. 31. Very light direct pencil on fol. 31b cannot be fully excluded from these images. The smudged marks along the upper ruled lines (about y 600–770) and at lower centre (about x 1490–2010, y 3590–3890) are likewise illegible and look like rubbing or offset, not writing.
unresolved.next_check: Use raking light or a higher-contrast, unmirrored capture of the top third of the leaf. Compare the traces mirrored against fol. 31 and fol. 32 to confirm show-through or offset. Check for any directly written pencil.
